task.title: Reduce cold filename traversal and warm-index filtering work
task.problem: Filename traversal stats every file and traverses all subdirectories; warm JSONL indexes still require a full scan.
task.proposal: Profile stat/metadata work and compile reusable filter predicates. Evaluate safe directory pruning for narrow include prefixes; consider an alternate index only when scan cost is material. Never publish a query-filtered index as a complete tree index.
acceptance: Broad and narrow patterns preserve the same match set as the current implementation.
Complete cached indexes remain valid across different later queries.
Report measured wall-time/RSS tradeoffs on fresh and warm indexes before changing format.
